texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]的细致调查发现了气象热脉冲的根源。

星罗棋布的地热喷口和间歇泉不断喷出高度易燃的气体，在大气中逐步累积。静电放电扮演起点燃催化的角色，导致爆炸性的气象锋面席卷整个星球的天空。

这些反应让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们对热动力燃烧获得了新的洞见，能在我们舰队的推进系统中加以应用
texts.en:
Detailed observation of [from.GetName] has revealed the cause of the meteorological heat spikes.

Geothermal vents and geysers across the surface are ejecting highly flammable gases which then accumulate in the atmosphere. Electrostatic discharges then act as an ignition catalyst, causing explosive weather fronts that ravage the skies of this world.

These reactions have given our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] new insights into thermodynamic combustion, with applications towards our own fleet's propulsion systems.

texts.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的精神创伤。
texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.

summary.text:
# 强热脉冲 / Intense Heat Spikes

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:800; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:2415 (extreme_frontiers.420)

## 如何开始 How it starts

有毒星球可能生成（6级，权重3，全局一次 max_once；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a toxic planet (level 6, weight 3, once per game via max_once; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.420“爆炸地平线”：非机械物种的领袖有约15%概率“创伤”、约15%概率“伤残”（随机权重170/15/15）；奖励为 d_exotic_gases_2 矿藏、每月工程研究，并推进下一个推进器科技（tech_thrusters_2…4，各25%）。

Single result extreme_frontiers.420 "Explosive Horizon": for a non-machine leader there is a roughly 15% chance of the traumatized and 15% of the maimed trait (random weights 170/15/15); the reward is a d_exotic_gases_2 deposit, monthly engineering research and 25% progress on the next thruster tech (tech_thrusters_2 to 4).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

420 的描述按领袖是否创伤/伤残变化。

420's description varies with whether the leader was traumatized or maimed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
